scheme_name: Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Setting Up Anchor Institute
other_conditions: Institute must be industry‑sponsored or a centre of excellence
Minimum of 10 years experience in its sector
Must operate in sectors such as biotechnology, marine, mining, shipbuilding, aerospace, agribusiness, etc.
Must have a proven track record of employment generation
Commitment to operate for a minimum of 10 years
Must function on a self‑sustaining model after 5 years
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹5 crore each for capital and operating expenditures, plus additional support for awareness programmes and trainee transport reimbursements.
